mapper.select:
SELECT A.PROJ_ID AS projId , A.PROJ_NM AS projNm , A.PROJ_TYPE AS projType , A.STATUS AS status , A.BILL_STATUS AS billStatus , A.BILL_STEP AS billStep , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt , CASE WHEN CURDATE() < A.START_DT THEN 0 WHEN CURDATE() > A.END_DT THEN 100 ELSE ROUND((DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), A.START_DT) / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(A.END_DT, A.START_DT), 0)) * 100, 0) END AS progressRate , B.CONT_NM AS contNm
, D.CUST_NM AS custNm , E.EMP_NM AS mainMgrNm , IF(F.FAV_ID IS NOT NULL, 'Y', 'N') AS favYn , (SELECT IFNULL( ROUND((SUM(IF(T.CONFIRM_YN = 'Y', T.INPUT_RATE, 0)) / NULLIF(A.EST_EFFORT, 0)) * 100, 1), 0 ) FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT T WHERE T.PROJ_ID = A.PROJ_ID ) AS actualProgressRate FROM TB_PROJECT A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CONTRACT B ON A.CONT_ID = B.CONT_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SALES C ON B.SALES_ID = C.SALES_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CUSTOMER D ON C.CUST_ID = D.CUST_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_EMP E ON A.M_EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_FAVORITE F ON A.PROJ_ID = F.TARGET_ID AND F.TARGET_TYPE = 'PROJECT' AND F.EMP_ID = #{loginId} WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND F.FAV_ID IS NOT NULL
AND A.PROJ_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY favYn DESC, A.PROJ_ID DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROJECT A WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND A.PROJ_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT A.PROJ_ID AS projId , A.PROJ_NM AS projNm , A.PROJ_TYPE AS projType , A.STATUS AS status , A.BILL_STATUS AS billStatus , A.BILL_STEP AS billStep , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt , A.EST_EFFORT AS estEffort , A.PROJ_REMARK AS projRemark , A.CONT_ID AS contId , A.M_EMP_ID AS mainMgrId , A.S_EMP_ID AS subMgrId , A.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId , CASE WHEN CURDATE() < A.START_DT THEN 0 WHEN CURDATE() > A.END_DT THEN 100 ELSE ROUND((DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), A.START_DT) / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(A.END_DT, A.START_DT), 0)) * 100, 0) END AS progressRate , B.CONT_NM AS contNm , B.CONT_AMT AS contAmt , C.SALES_TITLE AS salesTitle , D.CUST_NM AS custNm
, E.EMP_NM AS picUserNm , F.EMP_NM AS mainMgrNm , G.EMP_NM AS salesUserNm , H.EMP_NM AS subMgrNm , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT E2.EMP_NM SEPARATOR ', ') FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT ASGN INNER JOIN TB_EMP E2 ON ASGN.EMP_ID = E2.EMP_ID WHERE ASGN.PROJ_ID = A.PROJ_ID AND ASGN.DEL_YN = 'N') AS participantNames FROM TB_PROJECT A LEFT JOIN TB_CONTRACT B ON A.CONT_ID = B.CONT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SALES C ON B.SALES_ID = C.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER D ON C.CUST_ID = D.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP E ON B.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP F ON A.M_EMP_ID = F.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP G ON C.EMP_ID = G.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP H ON A.S_EMP_ID = H.EMP_ID WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROJECT SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TB_ASSIGNMENT ( PROJ_ID, EMP_ID, ASSIGN_TITLE, START_DT, END_DT, INPUT_RATE, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, CONFIRM_YN ) VALUES
( #{projId}, #{userId}, #{assignTitle}, STR_TO_DATE(#{startDt}, '%Y-%m-%d'), STR_TO_DATE(#{endDt}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{inputRate}, #{lastUpdusrId}, IFNULL(#{confirmYn}, 'N') )
mapper.select: SELECT ANY_VALUE(A.ASSIGN_ID) AS assignId , ANY_VALUE(A.PROJ_ID) AS projId , A.TASK_GROUP_ID AS taskGroupId , ANY_VALUE(A.ASSIGN_TITLE) AS assignTitle , ANY_VALUE(DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS startDt , ANY_VALUE(DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS endDt , ANY_VALUE(A.ATCH_FILE_ID) AS atchFileId , GROUP_CONCAT(B.EMP_NM SEPARATOR ', ') AS userNm , SUM(A.INPUT_RATE) AS inputRate , MAX(A.CONFIRM_YN) AS confirmYn FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT A INNER JOIN TB_EMP B ON A.EMP_ID = B.EMP_ID WHERE A.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.IN_OFFICE = 'Y' GROUP BY A.TASK_GROUP_ID ORDER BY ANY_VALUE(A.START_DT) DESC

SELECT IFNULL(MAX(daily_rate), 0) FROM ( SELECT SUM(INPUT_RATE) as daily_rate FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT WHERE EMP_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT (END_DT < #{startDt} OR START_DT > #{endDt}) GROUP BY EMP_ID ) AS temp

SELECT A.EMP_ID AS userId , A.EMP_NM AS userNm , A.DEPT_NM AS deptNm , A.POSITION_NM AS positionNm , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SUB.INPUT_RATE), 0) FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT SUB WHERE TRIM(SUB.EMP_ID) = TRIM(A.EMP_ID) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND SUB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN SUB.START_DT AND SUB.END_DT ) AS currentLoad FROM TB_EMP A WHERE A.IN_OFFICE = 'Y'
AND A.EMP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchNm}, '%')
ORDER BY A.EMP_NM ASC

SELECT A.ASSIGN_ID AS assignId , P.PROJ_NM AS projNm , A.ASSIGN_TITLE AS title , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt , A.INPUT_RATE AS inputRate FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT A INNER JOIN TB_PROJECT P ON A.PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID WHERE A.EMP_ID = #{userId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TB_ASSIGNMENT ( PROJ_ID, EMP_ID, ASSIGN_TITLE, START_DT, END_DT, INPUT_RATE, TASK_GROUP_ID, REQ_SKILLS, ASSIGN_REMARK, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, CONFIRM_YN, ATCH_FILE_ID ) VALUES
( #{projId}, #{item.userId}, #{assignTitle}, STR_TO_DATE(#{startDt}, '%Y-%m-%d'), STR_TO_DATE(#{endDt}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{item.inputRate}, #{taskGroupId}, #{reqSkills}, #{assignRemark}, #{lastUpdusrId}, IFNULL(#{confirmYn}, 'N'), #{atchFileId} )
mapper.select: SELECT A.ASSIGN_ID AS assignId , A.PROJ_ID AS projId , A.EMP_ID AS userId , B.EMP_NM AS userNm , A.ASSIGN_TITLE AS assignTitle , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt , A.INPUT_RATE AS inputRate , A.TASK_GROUP_ID AS taskGroupId , A.REQ_SKILLS AS reqSkills , A.CONFIRM_YN AS confirmYn , A.ASSIGN_REMARK AS assignRemark , A.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT A INNER JOIN TB_EMP B ON A.EMP_ID = B.EMP_ID WHERE A.TASK_GROUP_ID = #{taskGroupId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY B.EMP_NM ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ASSIGNMENT ( PROJ_ID, REQ_SKILLS, INPUT_RATE, START_DT, END_DT, DEL_YN, CONFIRM_YN, ASSIGN_TITLE, TASK_GROUP_ID, LAST_UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( #{projId}, #{reqSkills}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 'N', 'N', #{assignTitle}, CONCAT('TG_', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s')), #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT ANY_VALUE(A.ASSIGN_ID) AS assignId , ANY_VALUE(A.PROJ_ID) AS projId , A.TASK_GROUP_ID AS taskGroupId , ANY_VALUE(A.ASSIGN_TITLE) AS assignTitle , ANY_VALUE(DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS startDt , ANY_VALUE(DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS endDt , ANY_VALUE(A.ATCH_FILE_ID) AS atchFileId , GROUP_CONCAT(B.EMP_NM SEPARATOR ', ') AS userNm , SUM(A.INPUT_RATE) AS inputRate , MAX(A.CONFIRM_YN) AS confirmYn FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT A INNER JOIN TB_EMP B ON A.EMP_ID = B.EMP_ID WHERE A.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.IN_OFFICE = 'Y'
AND B.EMP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchUserNm}, '%')
AND A.ASSIGN_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchAssignTitle}, '%')
AND A.CONFIRM_YN = #{searchConfirmYn}
GROUP BY A.TASK_GROUP_ID ORDER BY ANY_VALUE(A.START_DT) DESC

SELECT A.CONT_ID AS contId , A.CONT_NM AS contNm , C.CUST_NM AS custNm , A.CUST_ID AS custId , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt FROM TB_CONTRACT A LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER C ON A.CUST_ID = C.CUST_ID WHERE 1=1 AND TRIM(A.CONT_STATUS) = '계약완료' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROJECT P WHERE P.CONT_ID = A.CONT_ID AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY A.CONT_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FAVORITE (EMP_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})
